step1.p1: You're among the very first operators paying for OhMyDesk — and we're keeping the money flow radically simple.
step1.p2: No card on file. No Stripe fees. No surprise auto-charge. Just an invoice from us, a bank transfer from you, and your space stays unlocked for the period you pick.
step1.p3: Every dollar we save on payment processing goes straight back into shipping the features you've been asking for.

step2.title: Pick your plan
step2.subtitle: Both unlock every feature you have today. Premium adds smart locks and multi-location.
step2.earlyBirdLocked: Early-bird rate locked from your trial
step2.notSure: Not sure? Most single-location spaces pick
step2.notSureAfter: You can upgrade later — just write to

step3.title: Pick your billing period
step3.subtitle: {{plan}} — paid up-front. Longer commitment, better price.
step3.pricingNote: Pricing in USD. If you'd rather be invoiced in EUR at the current ECB rate, mention it in the notes on the next step.

step4.title: Who are we billing?
step4.subtitle: Prefilled from your space settings — edit if anything's different.
step4.notesPlaceholder: PO number, currency preference, cc accountant

step5.readOnlyNotice: You can share the {{plan}} option with your workspace owner. Only the owner can request the invoice and activate the subscription.
step5.invoiceSentNotice: Check {{email}} — an invoice with our bank details is on its way. Pay it at your convenience.
step5.activationNotice: Once the funds land in our account, we'll activate your subscription — usually within 3–5 business days of the transfer. If something's unclear or the payment is delayed, we'll reach out to sort it.

locked.hardLockNotice: Your subscription on {{space}} hasn't been renewed and the grace period has ended.
locked.softLockNotice: Your 90-day free trial on {{space}} has ended.
locked.hardLockHelp: Drop us an email and we'll get you sorted — usually a quick reply with payment status or a fresh invoice is all it takes.
locked.ownerHelp: To keep the calendar, members, bookings, and integrations running, upgrade to a paid plan. Two clicks, and we'll send you an invoice you can pay by bank transfer — no card required.
locked.nonOwnerHelp: Only the space owner can renew the subscription. Ask them to upgrade — we sent them reminders, but a nudge from you doesn't hurt.

locked.renewPrompt: . Renew before then and everything's exactly where you left it.
